what: three concave r5 rounds at the inner corner of a 20x20x15 notch, with the g2 corner patch
method: the notch's inner corner (40,20,5), three concave edges, set back by its ellipsoid, 1.25 sqrt 2 r = 8.84, its rounds eased over 0.8 r = 4 before it (together 12.84, within the notch's 15 mm vertical edge), and filled with six biquintic patches about a centre point, built G2 to the rounds, the faces and each other; one valid body with the faces of the ball corner but its sphere (12) and the six patches (18); across every seam of the corner, along its whole length, its ends included, the curvature jump is at most 1e-6 per mm (the ball's corner jumps 1/r = 0.2; within 11 mm of the corner: the hole's sections end 10.2 from it; the rounds' own G1 seams with the faces run past 15 mm)
